meta.name: geopandas
meta.description: Guidance and local audit tools for Python workflows that directly use GeoPandas GeoSeries, GeoDataFrame, spatial operations, or vector-data I/O.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 处理地理数据时,本地检查并给出操作指导
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常用 Python 分析带地理坐标的数据,需要确保操作正确。
copy.tagline_en: Run local audits and get guidance on geospatial data handling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often analyze geographic data in Python and want to keep your methods correct.

howto.what: 用户处理地理矢量文件时,Claude 会给出 GeoPandas 的代码示例:读写 shapefile/GeoJSON/GeoPackage,执行空间连接、几何计算、坐标转换、绘图等操作,并提示先检查 CRS。
howto.when: 当任务涉及读取、分析shapefile/GeoJSON/GeoPackage等矢量数据,或要求做空间连接、面积/距离计算、坐标转换等操作时触发。

say.text: 用 GeoPandas 读取这个 GeoJSON 文件并画地图。
say.note: 会给出 read_file 加 plot 的代码。

say.text: 把这两份矢量数据做空间连接,并按区域汇总人口。
say.note: 会示范 sjoin 和 groupby 的用法。

say.text: 将数据投影到 EPSG:3857 再算面积,并导出 GeoPackage。
say.note: 会包含 to_crs、area 与 to_file 示例。

howto.what_en: When a user is handling vector geographic files, Claude gives GeoPandas code examples: reading/writing shapefile/GeoJSON/GeoPackage, performing spatial joins, geometry calculations, coordinate transformations, and plotting, and reminds the user to check CRS.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task involves reading/analyzing vector data such as shapefile/GeoJSON/GeoPackage, or when the user asks for spatial joins, area/distance calculation, or coordinate transformation.

say_en.text: Read this GeoJSON with GeoPandas and show a map.
say_en.note: Will supply read_file plus plot examples.

say_en.text: Spatial-join these two vector datasets and aggregate population by region.
Reproject to EPSG:3857 before calculating areas, then export GeoPackage.
